summary: Frontend-only verification of the persistent Credits badge + gated CreditSplash modal on WEB and MOBILE (Expo web preview). All 10 interactive checks passed: badge renders with count=300 and '20% more' promo pill on both surfaces, splash auto-opens on Free plan (web), 'Maybe later' closes it and it doesn't re-appear same session, badge-click reopens on demand, 'Don't show this again' persists via localStorage and prevents auto-open across full reload while badge remains and stays clickable. Mobile parity verified: badge shows in Chats/Tasks/Research/You headers; tapping credits-badge-buy opens the web billing page via Linking (window.open captured https://nest-app-prep.preview.emergentagent.com/billing) with no crash/red screen.

issues: credits-badge did not render on /hire route during navigation sweep (badge present on /chats, /tasks, /research). Likely /hire has its own layout that doesn't render AppShell, or navigation to /hire redirected. Non-blocking for the spec (which only lists Chats/Tasks/Research) but worth confirming the Hire route uses the same AppShell so the badge remains persistent everywhere.

action_items: (Minor / verify) Confirm /hire route renders under AppShell so CreditsBadge persists there too (badge was absent during navigation sweep on web); if /hire uses a separate shell, mount CreditsBadge there as well for full persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: CreditSplash confirms Stripe return in useEffect with empty deps but uses `params`/`setParams` from useSearchParams inside — technically stale-closure safe here because the effect only runs once, but ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps would flag it. Consider referencing via useRef or adding a suppression comment.

CreditsBadge polls /billing/usage + /billing/credit-packs every 60s while the app is open — fine but could be replaced with the existing `teamnest:credits-changed` event driven refresh only, to reduce chatter (2 requests/min per client).
safeGet/safeSet duplication in CreditSplash — small util; consider extracting into /src/lib/storage.js for reuse (very minor).
seed_data_creation: None. Used amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 on web and 'Try the live demo' on mobile per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CreditsBadge is mounted in web AppShell.jsx and in each mobile tab screen header (index/tasks/research/you). Web badge uses `data-testid`; mobile badge uses `testID` which renders as `data-testid` in Expo web preview — same selectors work on both. Splash gating flags: localStorage `tn-credit-splash-hidden`='1' (permanent) and sessionStorage `tn-credit-splash-shown`='1' (per-session). Free plan + ≥100 credits currently auto-opens the modal (via the `plan_id === 'free'` branch) — expected per spec. Mobile tapping credits-badge-buy uses Linking.openURL(`${getBase()}/billing`), which in web preview surfaces as window.open — confirmed captured.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration for the reviewed feature.
